independent_quantities_that_settle_it: DECISIVE - session_b_share_two_sided did not move. 0625 = 0.509, 0626 = 0.504. The aggregate two-sided tape is dead neutral and marginally LOWER on the day the big prints supposedly flipped to 78.5% buy. Arithmetically the aggregate is a volume-weighted blend of the big-print population and the rest; for a 0.785 big-print block to blend to 0.504, the NON-big-print tape must be a net SELLER, and the more big-print volume there is the harder it must be selling. Large buy blocks matched against a mass of small sells is a roll/distribution signature, not accumulation. This is the quantity I used to settle it: it is computed from the same tape, is independent of the big-print channel, and does not require price.

driver_realization_check: weekend.carry_realization_flip: the driver's peak is AHEAD of Monday, not behind it, so Monday CARRIES the side - this is NOT a sell-the-news setup. The one wrinkle I record rather than paper over: carry_realization_flip's trigger is 'a FUNDAMENTAL-CARRY Friday (unrealized weather/storage driver AT THE CLOSE)', and this Friday was not that - the heat did not exist on Friday, it ARRIVED over the weekend. So the play is only partially triggered and what is really operating is magnitude.weekend_gap_delivery's fresh arm, which is a NEW driver landing in the seam rather than a carried one realizing. Both point the same way, and I am naming which one is actually doing the work so the mechanism that gets extrapolated is the right one. SECOND REALIZATION CHECK, on the driver E was carrying: E's exit was MOMENTUM_CARRY with a fadeable expiry/weekend-squaring half. That half HAS now realized and is gone - NGN26 expired at Friday's settle, and per my confound verdict the roll flow that inflated Friday's close-third buy print is a one-off that does not carry into Monday. So the Friday exit's mechanical component is spent and should NOT be inherited as momentum; only the fundamental component carries, and the fundamental component is now the weather, which is fresh. Decision-time surprise was +9 Bcf bearish (actual 76 against the strictly pre-print consensus of 67 captured 2026-06-25T06:25:05Z - I use the pre-print snapshot, not the served 74, because the auditor established storage_consensus's final capture is post-print and destroys ~78% of the decision-time surprise on exactly this print), and the tape closed that day +1,956 net BUY on 119,374 lots with phase two-sided shares [0.555 / 0.500 / 0.518] and big prints at a neutral 0.499 with no roll contamination. A market absorbing a bearish print and buying anyway is a bullish tell, and it is the cleanest full-session flow reading available to B - uncontaminated, on full volume, and the only one in the block that is both.
bias_to_B: UP, AND THE GAP OWNS IT. That second clause is the load-bearing half of this bridge. STRUCTURAL INSTRUCTION: because gap ownership resolves to WEEKEND_CYCLE_WEATHER, the weekend information reprices at the Sunday 18:00 ET reopen, which means B's overnight_gap_usd should carry the BULK of B's day-move and B's path_p50_curve - which starts at B's 08:00 ET open, i.e. AFTER the gap - should be modest, and flat-to-slightly-negative is entirely consistent with a solidly positive day-net. If B puts the move in the cash session instead of the seam, B can land the right net on a false mechanism, and the brief is explicit that a right net carrying a false mechanism is worse than a wrong net because the mechanism is what gets extrapolated. GAP BAND handed to B for B to decide on: roughly +350 to +800, centred near +600, derived by scaling weekend_gap_delivery's fresh arm to n0_net_sigma_10 = 614 at n0_range_pctile 18.3, net of the ~800 MW nuclear return; upside tail fatter than downside. It survives deleting E's contaminated limb 2 entirely, and limb 3 honestly does not fire. Do not launder limb 2 back in. A channel that reads the same under opposite conditions carries zero discriminating information. THE STAND-DOWN IS THE CONTRIBUTION. (3) DO NOT FIRE monday.seam_chainage_accommodation_gate. Its mature-chain arm (inherited age 3 >= 3) would tell B to size the day DEEP with a close near the low - the exact opposite of my read - but its trigger is explicitly scoped to 'a carry-Monday (R3 carries the D-1 side, NO fresh-shot gap)', and there IS a fresh-shot gap here. Its fade branch needs 'a gap that jumped WITH a mature swing to a FRESH CUM-EXTREME', and cumulative signed flow from the anchor is still NEGATIVE at -3,893 - the market is net-sold from the anchor, nowhere near a fresh up extreme.
